title: Malicious code in dsh-blue-team-mode (npm)
description: The dsh-blue-team-mode npm package versions 3.0.0-beta.17, 3.0.0-beta.18, and 3.0.0-beta.20 contain malicious code. Any computer with this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. Secrets and keys stored on the affected system must be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
